description: odoo-ai-agents hooks - SessionStart readiness probe + browser-MCP permission self-apply + state-root planning-permission self-apply + ETHOS @import injector + guarded legacy-state-root migration + UserPromptSubmit intent detector + SubagentStop grounding enforcement & continuation nudge & resource-teardown gate & terminal-status telemetry + PreToolUse delegate reminder & nested-background-spawn deny + Stop continuation nudge & browser-teardown advisory + SessionEnd allocator gc crash-backstop. The SessionEnd hook only SPAWNS a detached worker and returns in milliseconds, so its `timeout` here bounds that spawn ONLY - the reaping's real bounds live in the script, because a SessionEnd hook is aborted once the batch's other hooks finish regardless of the timeout declared here (see the script's own header for the measurement). The drive-to-done and browser-teardown hooks are ADVISORY (never hard-block; parse-continuation.sh in particular has a HARD CONTRACT to never block - see its own header). There is exactly ONE PreToolUse hard deny - block-nested-background-spawn.sh, matcher-scoped to the spawn tool (Agent|Task) - and it refuses a single shape: a SUBAGENT launching a child in the background (run_in_background true OR ABSENT, since background is the tool's default). The root is never denied, no other tool is ever denied (Bash with run_in_background: true stays free - it is how odoo-instance-ops launches builds), and it fails open on any unreadable payload. Its sibling remind-delegate.sh is unchanged and stays ADVISORY-only, always emitting the no-opinion value 'defer'. There are TWO SubagentStop hard blocks, both narrow and both scoped to the subagent only (never main): (1) the instance-teardown gate, which fires only on a live, non-shared lease that the SUBAGENT ITSELF provisioned (correlated from its own acquire/bind/heartbeat --run-id) at a turn end that neither reports a stopped run (continuation status BLOCKED or NEEDS_CONTEXT) nor forwards INSTANCE_HANDLE inside its continuation fence - it is NOT keyed on the literal DONE: every other status, an out-of-enum value, and a turn with NO machine-readable status at all are all gated. Main-context / orchestrator-owned leases are NOT hard-gated, they are reclaimed by the SessionEnd gc backstop, which reaps a dead owner pid immediately and falls back to the allocator TTL only when liveness cannot be verified at all (a different host, or no pid recorded); and (2) enforce-grounding.sh's OSM-grounding-lie gate, which fires once when a subagent's artifact CLAIMS OSM grounding but its transcript shows zero OSM tool calls (self-gating; silently approves any non-Odoo-shaped subagent - see the script's own header). The PermissionRequest matcher's browser-family alternation (chrome-devtools|playwright|pagecast, each optionally -headed) is a JSON-literal mirror of scripts/lib/browser_prefixes.py STATIC_SERVERS / scripts/lib/browser-mcp-servers.sh BROWSER_MCP_ALL_SERVERS (JSON cannot source either file) - keep the three lists in sync when a browser family is added or removed (V-19).
